findings.obligation: P1/L1: Work Items must keep refusing the round while it moves (no S2-S3 gap); K4 forbids editing approved supports
findings.observation: Non-blocking. The Work Items check passes today with [] (no rule refuses a made-up type in the new namespace) and the constant is frozen. If S2 only renames the exact old full names in StrayLoose* the check stays green (the made-up type is not on the list), but a future round type stays unseen by Work Items. If S2 instead gives Work Items a round-pattern read, the made-up type becomes refused and this check fails against a frozen [] with no allowed edit. S1 role check needs no change either way (Work Items has no round pattern field in PatternRoles).
findings.remediation: Design decides in S2 whether Work Items reads exact renamed names or the round pattern; if the pattern route is chosen, S2 must not rely on this check staying green (it would need an authorised oracle amendment before S2 approval). Craft S1 is unaffected.
